mission.title: Emergency Response
mission.description: Answer the Machine field teams' reports of the strange code signature.

phase.briefing:
As you may know, we have several teams working on different aspects of the Anome situation. One of them has just reported the strange code signature in their vicinity.
Go to their location and assess the situation.

enter.say: That code signature is all over the place here, and it sounds like they're losing contact with the other team! Get in there and help out however you can!
Some of Anome's people! Take them out.

done.say:
Looks like we're too late to help them.
I'm getting some reports of the code signature elsewhere. Get out of here and we'll get in touch with Gray.

phase.briefing:
Another team is reporting the same code signature in their vicinity. It is urgent that we do not experience the same results.
Proceed to the location indicated and save the team.

enter.say: There are two members of that team left in there -- Jamie Harvey and Tomasa Quada. Once you've taken care of Anome's people, get them out of there safely.

objective.text: Lead Jamie Harvey and Tomasa Quada out of the area
Do not let Jamie Harvey or Tomasa Quada die

phase.briefing:
Yet another team has reported a sighting of the strange code signature, operative. Fortunately, we were able to evacuate them from the area before any harm came to them.
Now comes your job. Anome and his thugs are not to be allowed free rein in the Matrix, to do as they will. Their actions must be curtailed.
Take the operatives with you and put an end to any of these hooligans you can find.

enter.say: Wow. I'm reading exactly one boatload of bad guys in there, {player}. Go to it!

done.say: Talk about a bloodbath! I think even an arrogant idiot like Anome would sit up and take notice of that.

objective.text: Do not let Jamie Harvey or Tomasa Quada die

mission.finish:
A fine moment, {player}. If we cannot yet threaten Anome directly, or destroy his base of operations, we can make it extremely... unpleasant for him to move against us.
Rest assured that we will find a way to destroy him. It is... inevitable.
